index_title: JTools - Simplify Your Group's Day-to-Day (Android Only)
index_tagline: The Ultimate Life-Sync App for Groups.
index_logic_1: Seamless Shared & Private Group Management. JTools is built around collaborative groups. Create or join shared groups effortlessly using Group IDs (with member approval) or direct email invitations, or switch to your automatic Private Group for 100% isolated personal notes, documents, and private schedules.
index_logic_2: Instant Cloud Sync. No more waiting or manual refreshes. Our cloud-powered lists, notes, and task states sync across every device in your group instantly. When one person checks off an item or updates a schedule, everyone sees it right away.
index_logic_3: Professional Accuracy. From precise work timers with real-time overtime tracking to aisle-tagged shopping lists and Google Drive document vaults, JTools brings professional-grade organization to your personal and shared ecosystem.
index_section_subtitle: Designed to eliminate daily coordination friction between partners, roommates, and teams.
index_feat_app_features_desc: Discover how the internal Launcher unifies all productivity apps into one uncluttered home screen with custom gestures and theme controls.
index_feat_vaults_desc: Upload documents to your Google Drive, organize with tags, and share important files safely within your group.
index_feat_more_desc: When you start using the app, you will be able to request more features, or enjoy the other people's requested features as they are added to the app.
index_feat_calendar_desc: Advanced month and day grids tied directly to your Google Calendar. Categorize by event type and share group invites instantly.
index_feat_work_desc: High-visibility centered timer for shift work. Real-time overtime tracking and Google Calendar syncing let you know exactly when the workday is done.
index_feat_shopping_desc: Tag shopping items by aisle with decimal quantities and unit suggestions. With instant sync, your household stays stocked without double-buying.
index_feat_hub_desc: Checklists, text notes, saved web links, and a duration Time Calculator—synced in real time via Google Firebase under your active group.
index_feat_cleaning_desc: The ultimate roommate tool. Assign recurring chores, track last-cleaned dates, and maintain a shared living space friction-free.
index_feat_trendify_desc: Track anything from workout progress to savings. Visualize personal or group data with multi-person graphs and trend analysis.
index_support_desc: Through our built-in Support Hub, you can report bugs or suggest new features directly to the developer. Your feedback directly influences JTools's development roadmap.
index_cta_desc: jTool is currently in active Alpha. Connect with us to get early access, test new features, and help shape the app!
privacy_intro: jTool ("we," "our," or "the App") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share information when you use our mobile application.
privacy_p1: To provide synchronization features between users in the same group and personal productivity tools, we collect the following information via Google Firebase:
cal_tag: Seamless event synchronization and group scheduling.
cal_desc: Calendar connects directly with your Google Calendar to provide high-visibility month and day grids for your group.
cal_l1: Color-Coded Event Types: Select designated colors to represent work and activity types, enabling seamless calendar management and direct Work Page integration.
cal_l2: Dual-State Month Grid & Gestures: Swipe down to open the full-screen boxes grid view with event cards; swipe up to return to compact dots view with selected date agenda at bottom.
cal_l3: Native Recurring Events: Create recurring events (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly) powered directly by Google Calendar's native RRULE settings.
cal_l4: Collaborative Invitations & Inline Settings: Accept or decline group invites live and configure displayed or destination Google Calendars directly inside the 3-dots action menu with zero extra navigation.
clean_tag: Keep shared living spaces clean and organized friction-free.
clean_desc: Assign household chores, set recurring frequencies, and track last-cleaned dates with your roommates.
hub_tag: Your central notes, web links, and duration calculator.
hub_desc: Notes & Links is your personal and group scratchpad for notes, checklists, saved web links, and time calculations.
hub_faq_q1: Are my personal notes shared with my group?
hub_faq_a1: If you create a note while connected to an active group, it is shared with your group members so everyone can view it and leave comments. For strictly private personal data, simply switch to your automatically generated Private Group in Group Settings where only you have access.
shop_tag: Effortless household management with real-time group syncing.
shop_desc: The shopping list in JTools is built for groups. Whether it's a family household or a shared office, everyone stays on the same page.
trend_tag: Visualize your progress and identify patterns with personal and group trackers.
trend_desc: Trendify is JTools's data analysis engine. It allows you to track any numeric value over time and see the results on intuitive graphs.
vaults_tag: Secure file organization and sharing for your group.
vaults_desc: JTools Vaults acts as a central hub for your group's most important documents. Instead of uploading files to unknown custom servers, Vaults integrates directly with your Google Drive. You can upload local documents, photos, or camera captures into a dedicated Google Drive folder and share access with your group, while JTools stores only metadata and secure references in Firestore.
vaults_why_gdrive_title: Why Google Drive & Not Custom Servers?
vaults_why_cost_desc: Hosting custom file servers passes heavy monthly cloud storage fees down to users. By utilizing your existing Google Drive, JTools significantly reduces costs for the end user.
vaults_why_sec_desc: Your sensitive documents never reside on third-party servers. They remain encrypted in your Google Drive, protected by Google's world-class security infrastructure.
work_tag: Master your time, track your shifts, and never miss a finish line.
work_track_overview_desc: Workday is designed for precise shift and session timekeeping. It tracks elapsed time, goal progress, and real-time overtime directly against your Google Calendar. While heavily optimized for shift work, it can track ANY scheduled Google Calendar event or session—from freelance projects and study blocks to team meetings.
work_rc_banner_title: Actions Container: Primary Actions & Background Hub
work_rc_banner_desc: Note: Starting and finishing shift timers is handled directly by the centered circular clock button. On Workday, the Actions Container manages background task progress, unread notification alerts, and side-switching gestures.
vaults_rc_banner_desc: Primary Action: Houses the Plus FAB to instantly create new vaults or upload documents. Secondary: Tracks active Google Drive background uploads, offline downloads, public exports, and notifications.
cal_rc_banner_desc: Primary Action: Houses the Plus FAB to quickly schedule new events and send group invitations. Secondary: Manages notification badges for shared invite updates, event comments, and background transfers.
shop_rc_banner_desc: Note: Rapid item entry is handled by the dedicated Fixed Bottom Adding Bar docked at the bottom of the screen. On Shopping, the Actions Container manages background group sync alerts, notification badges, and side-switching gestures.
hub_rc_banner_desc: Primary Action: Houses the Plus FAB to quickly draft checklists, text notes, or save web links. Secondary: Tracks unread notification badges and background cloud sync status.
clean_rc_banner_desc: Primary Action: Houses the Plus FAB to instantly add new recurring household chores and tasks. Secondary: Delivers group chore completion alerts, notification badges, and side gestures.
trend_rc_banner_desc: Primary Action: Houses the Plus FAB to create new numeric trackers or add metric entries. Secondary: Delivers group trend updates, notification badges, and background queue tracking.
support_rc_banner_desc: Primary Action: Houses the Plus FAB to instantly create new support requests. Secondary: Delivers notifications when the developer responds and manages side gestures.
support_tag: Direct communication with the developer for bugs and feature requests.
support_desc: The Support Hub allows users to submit Bug reports, Feature requests, and Change requests directly to the JTools team, with automatic device info attachment and search/status filtering.
support_l1: Bug & Crash Reports: Submit bugs with steps to reproduce (or review Crash reports) with device details attached automatically so issues can be fixed quickly.
support_l2: Feature & Change Requests: Suggest new features or request changes to existing functionality that would improve your JTools experience.
support_l3: Real-Time Status Tracking & Filters: Track ticket statuses (Opened, In Progress, Closed, Cut) and search by ticket #number or filter by type and status.
support_l4: Two-Way Communication: Chat directly with the developer via comments on your specific support tickets.
support_pro_1: Be Descriptive: When reporting a bug, include the steps you took before the issue occurred. This helps the developer reproduce and fix it much faster.
support_faq_q1: Who can see my support tickets?
support_faq_a1: Support tickets are private between you and the JTools admin/reviewer team. Your group members cannot see your tickets. Note that a daily request limit applies, and tickets can only be deleted by you if their status is marked Cut.
rc_page_tag: The Actions Container is JTools's unified floating action and progress hub. Present across app screens, it tracks background transfers, alerts, and quick actions with smooth spring physics and side gestures.
app_features_title: App Features & Launcher System - JTools Guide
af_page_tag: The unified, all-in-one productivity environment designed to eliminate home screen clutter and simplify group collaboration under one roof.
af_why_launcher_title: Why jTool Uses an Internal Launcher?
af_why_launcher_desc: Traditional multi-tool setups force users to install 10 separate apps or clutter their phone home screens with endless single-purpose icons. JTools unifies all 9 essential household and group tools—Vaults, Calendar, Workday, ShopList, Notes, Links, Cleaning, Trends, and Time—under a single, customizable Launcher screen. You get a clean, uncluttered phone with instant access to every tool, plus built-in app search.
af_acc_1_title: 1. How to Use & Customize the Launcher
af_acc_1_l1: Layout Toggles (1 to 4 Columns): Long-press any app card to enter Edit Mode, then switch between 1–2 column side-by-side cards and 3–4 column compact grid cards.
af_acc_1_l2: Drag & Drop Reordering: In Edit Mode, touch and drag any app card to arrange your most frequently used tools at the top, then tap Save to keep your changes (or press Back to discard).
af_acc_1_l3: Visibility Controls: Tap the eye icon on any card in Edit Mode to hide it, or expand the "Hidden Apps" drawer at the bottom to reveal hidden tools.
af_acc_1_l4: Custom Launcher Gestures: Map 2 custom gestures (Swipe Left, Swipe Right) to open specific apps or trigger quick actions directly from the home screen.
af_acc_2_l1: Dark & Light Mode Toggling: Switch between sleek dark slate and soft, eye-friendly contrast light mode in General Settings.
af_acc_2_l2: Accent & Background Color Palettes: Personalize button highlights, progress rings, and surfaces with custom Primary Accent (15 options) and Background Color (6 options) palettes for both Dark and Light modes.
af_acc_2_l3: Where to Customize Themes: Navigate to Launcher → Settings → General Settings to toggle Dark/Light mode, set your Language or Weekly Start Day, and tap Customize Theme to pick your colors.
af_acc_3_l1: Instant Group Cloud Sync: Powered by Google Firebase, items added or checked off by group members update live on everyone's device.
af_acc_3_l2: Notification Badges: Unread notification counts display live on the Launcher top app bar bell icon and Actions Container widget.
af_acc_3_l3: Real-time Comment & Support Alerts: Receive instant notification alerts whenever other users update support requests or leave event comments.
af_rc_banner_desc: Learn how the Actions Container manages primary action buttons, background transfer queues, and side-switching gestures across the app.
viz_disclaimer_body: Note: This visualization provides a feel and understanding of the app's layout rather than representing a 100% pixel-perfect snapshot of every screen state.
groups_page_title: Group Architecture & Core Mechanics - JTools Guide
groups_page_tag: Groups are the core foundation binding all JTools applications together. Whether managing shared family lists, partner calendars, or roommate chores—or working privately in your personal Private Group—everything syncs seamlessly through your active Group context.
calendar_reminderDesc: Create standalone reminders with custom lead times and color alerts. Pick from multiple notification alert lead times (At time, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1d before) to receive standard phone notifications for timed events.
vaults_shareWizardTitle: System Share Target & Guided Import Wizard
vaults_shareWizardDesc: Share files directly from any app via Android's share menu. jTools will launch a guided 4-step wizard to import your files:
vaults_pinVaultDesc: Pin important vaults to the top of your list for instant access via each vault's action menu.
rc_blue_desc: Driven by the background FileUploadWorker, this FAB pops up automatically during active Google Drive uploads—even when editing existing documents or replacing files—for non-obstructive usage. Tap to view the detailed Upload Progress Sheet.
vaults_faq_a3: The top search bar strictly filters Vault names and descriptions. To search specific files across all your group's vaults, tap the floating magnifying glass icon (FindInPage FAB) to open the Cross-Vault Document Search.
vaults_replica_2_desc: Inside a Vault, you can view, add, or download the files attached to it directly from Google Drive. Both the Vaults list and specific Vault screens feature the floating FindInPage search button for quick cross-vault document access.
vaults_replica_1_desc: Shows your main list of Vaults. The floating magnifying glass (FindInPage FAB) searches specific files across all your group's vaults via the Unified Dual-Tab Filter & Sort Sheet.
